title: Jubilant Fluffy Uruguayan Rice Fried Rice
description: A kid-friendly Uruguayan dish featuring dark chocolate chips and halal-friendly ingredients, this charred and fluffy fried rice is a unique twist on traditional fried rice recipes. It is made with fry-grind-rice-khao-khua and is perfect for a quick snack or meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the toasted and ground khao khuat, salt, and pepper, and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is well coated.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the skillet or wok, then add a little more oil if necessary and scramble in the eggs until they are cooked through.
Mix the eggs into the rice mixture, then stir in the dark chocolate chips.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the chocolate is melted and the rice is heated through.
Serve the jubilant fluffy Uruguayan rice fried rice hot, garnished with additional dark chocolate chips if desired.
